title: Product traceability
lead: The barcode identifies a product. Sources determine what can actually be verified about it.
empty_state: No traceability verification data has been supplied to this view.
principle: Absence is not a negative verdict. BOTIA only shows what the source supports for the exact subject and scope identified.
disclaimer: A barcode identifies. Sources verify. BOTIA does not fill the gaps.

status.NOT_VERIFIED: Not verified in the sources consulted

runtime.scope_warning: This evidence applies only to the scope shown. BOTIA does not automatically extend it to another product, brand, parent company, market or plant.
runtime.not_verified_note: No negative conclusion is drawn from this result.

service_state.SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: The source could not be consulted. This does not mean that no evidence exists.
service_state.INVALID_GTIN: The code read is not a valid GTIN, so no source could be consulted.

runtime.contract_error: This item was not displayed as verified because required traceability fields were missing.

robot_questions: What source does this ingredient come from, and can it be traced back to the manufacturer, batch or certification?
Can the origin of this ingredient be verified by product, manufacturer, market or batch?
